title: Submit through a Git branch with tools/alchemy_submit.py
summary: The Git route is the preferred route for any chat that can push to animatedads/alchemy. tools/alchemy_submit.py checks the package, fetches main, builds a temporary worktree (your checkout is not switched), commits the package to autobuild/inbox/<id>/package, commits autobuild/inbox/<id>/ready.json, and pushes both commits to one branch, autobuild-submit/<id>. The service picks the branch up and writes autobuild/receipts/<id>.json.
invariants: ready.json schema is alchemy.autobuild.git-submission/0.1 and names package_path "package".
Symlinks anywhere in the package are refused; nested .git directories are dropped.
Submission ids are generated (UTC time, producer, label, random suffix); do not reuse one.
Do not also push the same package path to main by hand: when autobuild runs, a different existing tree is an ERROR.
procedure: Dry run from your clone: python3 tools/alchemy_submit.py --package <dir> --submitted-by CHATGPT --dry-run --json
Record the returned submission_id and branch in your update.
Later, look for autobuild/receipts/<submission_id>.json on main.
